about: OWNER approvals of per-league threshold proposals (owner rule 2026-10-26: the monthly backtest PROPOSES, the owner approves). Each approval names a proposal in output/threshold_proposals/ by proposal_id + proposal_hash and lists the approved entries by entry_id + entry_hash ONLY - never a threshold value. `python -m src.threshold_apply --proposal <file>` applies exactly those entries and re-approves the research lock as approved_by. An entry not listed here never reaches production.
